msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia moda-tammara-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a bright red short wool jacket over a burgundy striped top and light blue jeans from the reference, walking at a sunny street in Peligros, Granada, Spain, with white buildings and the Sierra Nevada mountains in the distance, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-tammara-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a fluffy dark brown faux fur jacket (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-tammara-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of a navy satin blouse with a pussy bow, straight blue jeans and burgundy heeled ankle boots (flat lay) from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-tammara-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown knit wrap cardigan with a belt over black trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia moda-tammara-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy and lilac striped long-sleeve top with straight blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
